answer: Inbound settlement uniqueness: an agent unlocks spendable rewards only after receiving a real micro-deposit from a distinct regulated payment rail that no other agent has used. Honest agents clear this once with one banked inbound. A sybil farm must buy a fresh rail per shell, so its fakes cannot share one reef of accounts; each new plume of identities burns KYC fees and float, a velvet cost that grows linearly and never recycles.
